where: Vesper Crossroads — the Lanternway hub where the five lit lanes meet (waystone, waystation inn, fingerpost)
mood: The Signpost Tune — all roads meet here: a road-folk waystation band strikes up the home tune, lute, reed and tambourine on the front porch of the world.
_note: Classic twin: assets/audio/midi/specs/vesper-crossroads-a.json (108 BPM, 4/4, C major, plain Vesper statement in bars 1-2, I-vi-IV-V). Remaster written at 90 BPM because motif medium pins the take to the motif's 90 grid (the hub is the motif's cosy home base). Palette deliberately unlike tinderwick-a (music-box/harp/string pad): a road-folk band instead.
core_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
accordion-like sampled reed organ playing the melody
plucked sampled lute strumming the chords
plucked sampled bass walking root and fifth
a sampled fiddle answering the tune
friendly road-folk waystation band at a crossroads inn, welcoming and a little busy

sections.name: Strike Up
sections.text: {the band strikes up: a tambourine shake and a lute strum pickup, the hand-drum starts walking, and the reed lead launches straight into the tune}

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {the signpost tune on the reed: the hometown melody's hopeful rising lift and settle home, played friendly and folksy over strummed lute and a walking hand-drum}

sections.name: Main Theme Reprise

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast: a warm turn to A minor and F major, the fiddle takes the lead for a wistful travelling phrase, the lute picks single notes, then the band lifts back home}
